title: Consumer UAV — Unauthenticated Telnet Root Access
description: An unauthenticated remote attacker on the drone's Wi-Fi can reach an open Telnet service on port 23 that drops to a BusyBox root shell, allowing arbitrary read, modification, and process control on the airframe.
technicalDetails: Drone advertises an access point; Telnet (TCP/23) is exposed with no authentication and serves a uid=0 shell. From there: read flight logs and media, modify configuration, install persistence, or force a landing.

title: Holy Stone Remote ID Module — Unauthenticated Remote Power-Off
product: Holy Stone Remote ID Module HSRID01
affectedVersions: Firmware shipped with Drone Go2 app < 1.1.8
description: In broadcast mode the Remote ID module can be powered off by an unauthenticated Bluetooth peer issuing repeated reads against the ASTM Remote ID (0xFFFA) GATT characteristic, triggering an out-of-bounds read and fault.
technicalDetails: Connect over BLE without auth; repeated reads on characteristic 0xFFFA cause a buffer over-read that faults the device into power-off — a denial of the Remote ID broadcast itself.

title: DJI Mavic 3 — Weak QuickTransfer Wi-Fi Key Generation
description: QuickTransfer Wi-Fi passwords are an 8-character hex string derived from libc random() seeded weakly, giving a small key space that a remote attacker can derive to join the network and potentially decrypt traffic.
technicalDetails: WPA2-PSK is generated from only a few random() draws, collapsing the effective key space (CWE-334, small space of random values). An attacker recovers the PSK and authenticates without permission.

title: DJI Mavic 3 — vtwo_sdk Memory Corruption (DUML)
description: Memory corruption in the vtwo_sdk service reachable over the DUML protocol, one of a cluster of issues surfaced by protocol fuzzing of DJI airframes.
technicalDetails: Malformed DUML messages reach vtwo_sdk and corrupt memory; part of the 16-issue cluster from DUML fuzzing reported around NDSS 2023.

title: DJI Mavic 3 — vtwo_sdk Memory Corruption (variant)
description: A second memory-corruption path in vtwo_sdk reachable via DUML, distinct from CVE-2023-51454.
technicalDetails: Variant of the vtwo_sdk DUML cluster; differs in the field that triggers the out-of-bounds write.

title: DJI Mavic 3 — vtwo_sdk Memory Corruption (variant)
description: A third DUML-reachable memory-corruption path in vtwo_sdk.
technicalDetails: Variant of the vtwo_sdk DUML cluster.
